title: Frequently asked questions
lead: Anything else? Contact us from the support page.

what.a: LinClone is an AI clone app for fans: AI chat, AI voice calls, morning calls and LIVE shows with official AI clones of your favorite creators. It works on iPhone and Android, in Japanese and English.

real.q: Am I talking to the real creator?
real.a: No. All creator profiles are AI clones. You talk with an official AI clone approved by the creator, and LIVE shows and Stories are marked as AI-generated.

free.a: The app is free to download and your first 60 seconds of calling are free. For more, you can buy coins or a plan in the app. See pricing in the app.

account.a: You can try your first call before creating an account. After that, just continue with Apple or Google. No password needed.

video.a: No. Calls are voice-only, and LIVE shows are audio shows too.

morning.q: Will a morning call always ring?
morning.a: It rings on your lock screen like a phone call, but your phone’s Focus or Do Not Disturb settings may stop it. The app shows you how to let it through.

memory.q: Can I delete what they remember?
memory.a: Yes. In “Our bond & memories” you can see, edit or delete what they remember, anytime.

payment.a: Only through App Store or Google Play in-app purchase. Every spend asks you to confirm first, and coins for failed generations are refunded automatically.

oshikatsu.q: How does it fit into my day?
oshikatsu.a: A morning call to start the day, chat in the gaps, calls and LIVE at night. With Grow, you can even help their AI learn who they really are.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: You can delete it from Settings in the app. See the account deletion page for details.

creator.q: I’m a creator. How do I join?
creator.a: See the page for LC Studio, our app for creators.
